item.title: Myongji University Successfully Concludes '1st Energy Citizens' Assembly for Everyone'... 100 Citizens Propose 'Urban Solar Income' Policy (명지대, '제1회 모두의 에너지시민회의' 성료… 시민 100인과 '도시형 햇빛소득' 정책 제안)
item.description:
Myongji University (President Yim Yeon-soo) announced that it successfully held the '1st Energy Citizens' Assembly for Everyone: Citizens Creating Urban Solar Income Villages and Energy Transition' from 1:00 PM to 6:00 PM on Saturday, June 27, at the International Conference Hall on the first floor of the Bangmok Academic Information Center on its Humanities Campus. (명지대학교(총장 임연수)는 지난 6월 27일(토) 오후 1시부터 6시까지 인문캠퍼스 방목학술정보관 1층 국제회의장에서 ‘제1회 모두의 에너지시민회의: 시민이 만드는 도시형 햇빛소득마을과 에너지 전환’을 성황리에 개최했다고 밝혔다.)

This event is the final stage of the '2026 Myongji Climate and Energy Transition Academy – Urban Solar Income Village Citizens' School 1st Cohort.' It was co-hosted by Myongji University's Bangmok College of General Education, the Green Transition Research Institute, the Citizen Development Heterogeneous Cooperative Association, the Women's Environmental Solidarity, the Energy and Climate Policy Institute, and the Solar Dividend National Network. (이번 행사는 ‘2026 명지 기후·에너지 전환 아카데미–도시형 햇빛소득마을 시민학교 1기’의 최종 과정이다. 명지대학교 방목기초교육대학, 녹색전환연구소, 시민발전이종협동조합연합회, 여성환경연대, 에너지기후정책연구소, 햇빛배당전국네트워크가 공동으로 주최했다.)

()

The Urban Solar Income Village Citizens' School is a professional training program where citizens directly design renewable energy transition models suitable for urban environments. Out of 270 nationwide applicants, 40 final participants were selected, including individuals and activists from civil society, public institutions, schools, and policy areas. From May, they studied urban renewable energy policies, solar technology, business structures, cooperative operations, and the solar dividend model over eight weeks, designing models applicable to Seoul and the metropolitan area. (도시형 햇빛소득마을 시민학교는 도시 환경에 적합한 재생에너지 전환 모델을 시민이 직접 설계하는 전문가 양성 프로그램이다. 전국에서 270명이 지원한 가운데 시민사회·공공기관·학교·정책 분야 관계자 및 활동가 등 최종 40명이 선발됐다. 이들은 지난 5월부터 8주간 도시형 재생에너지 정책, 태양광 기술, 사업 구조, 협동조합 운영, 햇빛배당 모델 등을 학습하며 서울과 수도권에 실제 적용 가능한 모델을 설계했다.)

()

At the assembly, following presentations of six urban solar income village models researched by the trainees, 11 group deliberation discussions began in earnest, involving a total of 100 participants, including citizens' school members and general citizens. (이날 회의에서는 교육생들이 연구한 6개의 도시형 햇빛소득마을 모델 발표에 이어, 시민학교 참여자와 일반 시민 등 총 100명이 참여하는 11개 모둠 숙의 토론이 본격적으로 펼쳐졌다.)

()

Citizens participating in the discussions explored ways to expand renewable energy using various urban spaces, such as public idle sites, schools, apartment complexes, and riversides. Furthermore, they gathered in-depth opinions on establishing resident-participatory operational structures, the feasibility of profit-sharing and solar dividend models, and the need for administrative support and legal/institutional improvements to back these efforts. (토론에 참여한 시민들은 공공 유휴부지, 학교, 공동주택, 하천변 등 도시 안의 다양한 공간을 활용한 재생에너지 확대 방안을 모색했다. 나아가 주민 참여형 운영 구조의 정착, 수익 공유와 햇빛배당 모델의 실현 가능성, 이를 뒷받침할 행정 지원 및 법·제도 개선의 필요성에 대해 심도 있는 의견을 모았다.)

()

The event was moderated by Professor Kim Hyo-jung of Myongji University's Bangmok College of General Education. After the opening address by Dean Moon Sun-woong of the Bangmok College of General Education, the event was graced by congratulatory speeches from Park Woon-ki, Mayor-elect of Seodaemun-gu; Kang Hee-young, Executive Director of the Nowon Environmental Foundation and Co-Representative of the Women's Environmental Solidarity; and Geum Min, Chairman of the Presidential Special Committee on Solar and Wind Income. (행사는 김효정 명지대학교 방목기초교육대학 교수의 사회로 진행됐다. 문선웅 방목기초교육대학 학장의 개회사에 이어 박운기 서대문구청장 당선인, 강희영 노원환경재단 상임이사이자 여성환경연대 공동대표, 금민 대통령 직속 햇빛·바람소득특별위원회 위원장이 축사를 맡아 자리를 빛냈다.)

()

In the subsequent keynote session, Jeong Eun-jin, President of the Citizen Development Heterogeneous Cooperative Association; Oh Yong-seok, Deputy Director of the Green Transition Research Institute; and Oh Jin-woong, Director of Climate Citizen Communication at the National Climate Crisis Response Committee, gave presentations on citizen-led urban solar income villages, urban energy transition policies, and climate governance. Following the presentations, Professor Lee Myung-joo of Myongji University's Department of Architecture (Architectural Studies major), also a member of the National Climate Crisis Response Committee, provided a comprehensive review, evaluating the policy implications and feasibility of the models. (이어진 기조 강연 세션에서는 정은진 시민발전이종협동조합연합회 회장, 오용석 녹색전환연구소 부소장, 오진웅 국가기후위기대응위원회 기후시민소통국장이 나서 시민 주도의 도시형 햇빛소득마을과 도시형 에너지 전환 정책, 기후 거버넌스를 주제로 발표했다. 발표 이후에는 이명주 명지대학교 건축학부 건축학전공 교수이자 국가기후위기대응위원회 위원이 종합 논평을 맡아 모델의 정책적 의미와 실현 가능성을 평가했다.)

()

Professor Kim Hyo-jung, who planned and operated this Citizens' School, emphasized, "Climate crisis and energy transition are tasks that must go beyond the realm of governments and experts, requiring citizens to participate and co-create. This Citizens' Assembly is significant in that citizens directly designed urban renewable energy models and connected them to specific policy proposals through deliberation." (이번 시민학교를 기획·운영한 김효정 교수는 “기후위기와 에너지 전환은 정부와 전문가만의 영역을 넘어 시민이 함께 참여하고 만들어가야 할 과제”라며, “이번 시민회의는 시민들이 직접 도시형 재생에너지 모델을 설계하고, 숙의를 통해 구체적인 정책 제안으로 연결했다는 점에서 의미가 매우 크다”고 강조했다.)

()

Meanwhile, the lively opinions and results discussed at this Citizens' Assembly will be compiled into policy proposals and action plans to be shared with relevant institutions and networks in the future. Myongji University plans to use this event as a catalyst to spread citizen-led urban energy transition models and continue climate and energy transition education in connection with local communities. (한편, 이번 시민회의에서 논의된 생생한 의견과 도출된 결과는 향후 정책 제안서와 실행 과제로 정리되어 관련 기관 및 네트워크와 공유될 예정이다. 명지대학교는 이번 행사를 계기로 시민 주도형 도시 에너지 전환 모델을 확산하고, 지역사회와 연계한 기후·에너지 전환 교육을 지속적으로 전개해 나갈 계획이다.)

item.title: Yonsei University Launches 'AI Memory Semiconductor' Course with Former Samsung Professors – "Learn Real Semiconductors Beyond the Textbook" (연세대, 삼성 출신 교수진 모아 'AI 메모리 반도체' 과목 개설… "교과서 밖 진짜 반도체 배운다")
item.description:
Yonsei University (President Yoon Dong-sup) Department of System Semiconductor Engineering announced that it will open a course titled 'Special Topics in AI Memory Semiconductors' for undergraduate and graduate students starting Friday, September 4. This is a regular curriculum course focused on 'memory semiconductors' and will be led by industry-academia collaboration professors who are former executives of Samsung Electronics' Device Solutions (DS) division. (연세대학교(총장 윤동섭) 시스템반도체공학과는 오는 9월 4일(금)부터 학부생 및 대학원생을 대상으로 한 'AI향 메모리 반도체 특론' 강의를 개설한다고 밝혔다. 해당 수업은 '메모리 반도체'에 집중한 정규 과정 수업으로 삼성전자 반도체(DS) 부문 임원 출신 산학협력 교수진이 이끈다.)

The course is distinctive in adopting a 'top-down' approach that covers everything from product strategy to design and process technology, based on a macroscopic understanding of memory systems. In this course, professors with over 20 years of industry experience as former Samsung Electronics executives will teach students about the rapidly evolving development trends of AI memory systems and the latest technologies in DRAM, FLASH, and next-generation packaging (PKG). (이번 수업은 메모리 시스템에 대한 거시적 이해를 바탕으로 제품 전략부터 설계 및 공정 기술까지 다루는 ‘Top-down’ 방식의 접근법을 채택했다는 점에서 특징적이다. 해당 수업에서는 20년 이상 산업 현장에서 경력을 쌓은 삼성전자 임원 출신 교수진이 강단에 서서 급변하는 AI 메모리 시스템의 개발 트렌드와 DRAM, FLASH, 차세대 패키징(PKG) 분야의 최신 기술을 학생들에게 직접 전수한다.)

()

Starting with the first lecture, 'Semiconductor Technology and the AI Era,' by Seoul National University Special Professor Lee Jung-bae (former head of Memory Business), experts in related fields from Yonsei University, Seoul National University, Sungkyunkwan University, and KAIST, including Yonsei University Professor Kim Hyung-seop (former head of Semiconductor Research Institute), will participate as instructors. (서울대 이정배 특임교수(전 메모리사업부장)의 '반도체 기술과 AI 시대' 첫 강의를 시작으로 연세대 김형섭 교수(전 반도체연구소장) 등 연세대, 서울대, 성균관대, KAIST에 포진한 관련 분야 전문가들이 강사진으로 참여한다.)

()

The lecture curriculum is designed to reflect practical and latest technology trends. Key industry technical challenges are covered in depth, ranging from HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) design and logic process technology, to latest NAND solution technology for high-capacity AI storage, DRAM design and process, and next-generation device development strategies. (강의 커리큘럼은 실무 및 최신 기술 동향을 반영해 구성됐다. HBM(고대역폭 메모리)의 설계 및 로직 공정 기술부터, 고용량 AI 스토리지를 위한 최신 낸드(NAND) 솔루션 기술, DRAM 설계 및 공정, 차세대 소자 개발 전략에 이르기까지 산업계 주요 기술 과제들이 심도 있게 다뤄진다.)

()

A Yonsei University Department of System Semiconductor Engineering official stated, "In core future technology fields where there are no set answers, vivid industrial experience and know-how are more important than anything else," adding, "Through this course, students will be able to grow into practical memory semiconductor experts with creative and applied research capabilities suited to the AI era." (연세대 시스템반도체공학과 관계자는 "정답이 정해져 있지 않은 미래 핵심 기술 분야에서는 산업 현장의 생생한 경험과 노하우가 무엇보다 중요하다"며, "이번 강의를 통해 학생들이 AI 시대에 부합하는 창의적이고 실용적인 연구 역량을 갖춘 실무형 메모리 반도체 전문가로 성장할 수 있을 것"이라고 밝혔다.)

()

Meanwhile, this course will be held at Yonsei University's 4th Engineering Building and is open to graduate and undergraduate students from the Department of System Semiconductor Engineering and the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The course is co-sponsored by the Yonsei University AI Semiconductor Innovation Research Center (CINC) and Samsung Electronics, supporting the training of talent in the semiconductor field. (한편, 본 수업은 연세대 제4공학관에서 진행되며, 연세대 시스템반도체공학과 및 전기전자공학과 대학원생과 학부생을 대상으로 한다. 해당 수업은 연세대 AI 반도체 혁신 연구소(CINC)와 삼성전자가 함께 후원하며 반도체 분야 인재 양성을 지원한다.)

(<이 기사는 연세대학교에서 제공한 정보기사로 한겨레의 의견과 다를 수 있습니다.>)

item.title: "The 27th Kyung Hee University President's Cup National Middle and High School Golf Tournament" Concludes Successfully; Lee Ha-neul Wins Men's Division, Park Yu-seon Takes Overall Victory (‘제27회 경희대학교 총장배 전국 중·고등학생 골프대회’ 성료 이하늘 남자부 정상, 박유선 통합우승)
item.description:
The "27th Kyung Hee University President's Cup National Middle and High School Golf Tournament" came to a successful close after two days of intense competition from June 24 to 25 at High1 Country Club. This tournament was organized based on a business agreement (MOU) between Kyung Hee University's College of Physical Education, Kangwon Land, and 123HR Co., Ltd. Athletes in each division showcased stable game management and outstanding concentration amidst fierce competition, elevating the tournament's standard. (‘제27회 경희대학교 총장배 전국 중·고등학생 골프대회’가 6월 24일~25일 하이원CC에서 이틀간의 열전을 마치고 성황리에 막을 내렸다. 이번 대회는 경희대학교 체육대학, 강원랜드, (주)123HR의 업무협약(MOU)을 바탕으로 추진됐다. 각 부문 선수들은 치열한 경쟁 속에서도 안정적인 경기 운영과 뛰어난 집중력을 선보이며 대회의 수준을 높였다.)

In the high school men's division, Lee Ha-neul (Shinseong High School) claimed the title with a combined score of 5-under par. Kim Dong-woon (Suseong Bangtong High School) and Noh Seung-woo (Suseong Bangtong High School) secured second and third place, respectively. In the high school women's division, Park Yu-seon (Mokpo Bangtong High School) took the top spot with a combined score of 3-under par, followed by Go Ha-na (Hamyeol Girls' High School) and Park Ji-young (Seoul Automobile High School). (고등부 남자부에서는 이하늘(신성고)이 합산 5언더파를 기록하며 우승을 차지했다. 김동운(수성방통고)과 노승우(수성방통고)가 각각 2위와 3위에 올랐다. 고등부 여자부에서는 박유선(목포방통고)이 합산 3언더파로 정상에 올랐으며, 고하나(함열여고)와 박지영(서울자동차고)이 뒤를 이었다.)

In the middle school men's division, Seon In-tae (Shinseong Middle School) won with a combined score of 7-over par. Second place went to Shim Min-geon (Yedang Middle School), and third place to Kim Joo-won (Jijeong Middle School). In the middle school women's division, Lee Ha-nui (Miryang Girls' Middle School) won with a combined score of 1-over par, while Choi Min-ha (Cheongshin Girls' Middle School) and Park Soo-young (Yeongshin Middle School) took second and third place, respectively. (중등부 남자부에서는 선인태(신성중)가 합산 7오버파로 우승을 차지했다. 2위는 심민건(예당중), 3위는 김주원(지정중)이 기록했다. 중등부 여자부에서는 이하늬(밀양여중)가 합산 1오버파로 우승했으며, 최민하(청신여중)와 박수영(영신중)이 각각 2위와 3위에 이름을 올렸다.)

Notably, the overall victory, encompassing winners across all divisions, went to Park Yu-seon. After winning the high school women's division, Park achieved the most outstanding performance among all participating athletes, cementing her status as the top protagonist of this tournament. As this tournament granted a "2027 KLPGA High1 Dream Tour Main Round Entry Ticket" to the overall winner of the women's middle and high school divisions, the benefit was awarded to overall champion Park Yu-seon. (특히 각 부문 우승자를 모두 아우른 통합 우승은 박유선의 차지였다. 박 선수는 고등부 여자부 정상에 오른 데 이어 전체 출전 선수 중 가장 돋보이는 성과를 거두며 이번 대회 최고의 주인공으로 자리매김했다. 이번 대회는 여자 중·고등부 통합 우승자에게 ‘2027년 KLPGA 하이원 드림투어 본선 출전권’을 부여함에 따라 통합 우승자 박유선 선수에게 그 혜택이 주어졌다.)

Professor Beom Cheol-ho (Head of Department) from Kyung Hee University's Golf Industry Department stated, "The experience of hosting professional tournaments by Kangwon Land and 123HR Co., Ltd., along with their support in human infrastructure, greatly contributed to the successful hosting of this event. I extend my gratitude to all athletes and parents who participated in this tournament." (경희대 골프산업학과 범철호 교수(학과장)는 ‘강원랜드와 ㈜123HR의 프로대회 개최 경험과 인적 인프라의 지원이 대회를 성공 개최하는 데 많은 도움이 되었으며, 이번 대회 참가한 모든 선수와 학부모에게 감사한 마음을 전한다’고 밝혔다.)

Established in 1999, Kyung Hee University's Golf Industry Department has consistently produced talents active across the domestic golf industry. Notable Kyung Hee alumni include Park Sang-hyun and Moon Do-yeop, active on the KPGA, as well as Kim Min-byeol, Song Ga-eun, Lee Seung-yeon, and Lee Chae-eun 2 on the KLPGA. Furthermore, Kyung Hee graduates are also making their mark not only in professional circuits but across the entire golf industry, including golf course management, marketing, equipment, and media. item.title: Yonsei Professor Yoo Ki-jun’s Team Develops World’s First Transparent Conductive Nanofilm That Works in Rainwater, Seawater, and Bodily Fluids (연세대 유기준 교수팀, '빗물·바닷물·체액에서도 작동하는' 투명 전도성 나노막 세계 최초 개발)
item.description:
Professor Yoo Ki-jun of the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering at Yonsei University (President Yoon Dong-sup), in collaboration with an international research team including Professor Takao Someya and Professor Kenjiro Fukuda from RIKEN and the University of Tokyo, has developed the world’s first solution-processed transparent conductive nanofilm (BIPIN) that is stable in aqueous environments. Through this, they succeeded in simultaneously recording biosignals and performing real-time imaging without optical interference during skin attachment and cerebral cortex implantation. (연세대학교(총장 윤동섭) 전기전자공학부 유기준 교수는 일본 이화학연구소(RIKEN) 및 도쿄대학교 타카오 소메야(Takao Someya) 교수, 켄지로 후쿠다(Kenjiro Fukuda) 교수가 속한 국제 연구팀과 함께 세계 최초로 수계 환경에서 안정적인 용액 공정 기반의 투명 전도성 나노막(BIPIN)을 개발했다. 또한 이를 통해 피부 부착 및 뇌 피질 이식 상태에서 광 간섭 없이 생체 신호 기록과 실시간 이미징을 동시에 수행하는 데 성공했다.)

The system experimentally demonstrated that, even when exposed to various moist environments such as rainwater, seawater, and bodily fluids, it stably and accurately records electrophysiological signals without mutual interference and acquires images of deep blood vessels and brain neural networks. In particular, by fundamentally solving the moisture degradation and optical occlusion issues that inevitably occur with conventional electrodes, it can dramatically improve the accuracy of research based on bioelectronic devices in wet environments. The development of this technology is expected to establish itself as a core foundational technology for bio-optoelectronics research integrating electrical signal measurement and optical imaging, and is anticipated to broadly contribute to the advancement of underwater wearable devices and chronic implantable neural devices in the future. (본 시스템은 빗물, 바닷물, 체액 등 다양한 수분 환경에 노출된 상태에서도 상호 간섭 없이 전기 생리신호의 정확한 기록과 심부 혈관 및 뇌 신경망 이미지 획득이 안정적으로 수행됨을 실험적으로 입증했다. 특히, 기존 전극에서 불가피하게 발생하던 수분 열화 및 광학적 가림 현상을 근본적으로 해결함으로써, 습윤 환경에서의 생체 전자 소자 기반 연구의 정확도를 획기적으로 향상시킬 수 있다. 이러한 기술 개발을 통해 전기적 신호 측정과 광 기반 영상 기술을 통합하는 생체 광전자 공학 연구의 핵심 기반 기술로 자리 잡을 것으로 기대되며, 향후 수중 웨어러블 기기 및 만성 이식형 신경 장치 발전에도 폭넓게 기여할 수 있을 것으로 전망된다.)

( )

Various transparent electrode technologies have been developed to simultaneously record biosignals and perform optical imaging. However, existing transparent neural interfaces suffered from corrosion and mechanical delamination in aqueous environments, making long-term use difficult. Protective layers or gels have been applied to address this, but they limited device flexibility and adhesion to biological tissues. Additionally, metal nanowire-based electrodes encountered issues of oxidation and increased resistance in moist environments, degrading signal quality and biocompatibility. Thus, next-generation bio-optoelectronic devices have required new electrode technologies that can simultaneously achieve high conductivity, transparency, flexibility, and moisture resistance. (생체 신호 기록과 광학 이미징을 동시에 수행하기 위한 다양한 투명 전극 기술이 개발돼 왔다. 그러나 기존 투명 신경 인터페이스는 수계 환경에서 부식과 기계적 박리가 발생해 장기간 사용이 어려웠다. 이를 보완하기 위해 보호층이나 젤을 적용하기도 했지만, 소자의 유연성과 생체 조직 밀착성이 저하되는 한계가 있었다. 또한 금속 나노와이어 기반 전극은 수분 환경에서 산화와 저항 증가로 신호 품질과 생체 적합성이 떨어지는 문제가 있었다. 따라서 차세대 생체 광전자 소자에는 높은 전도성과 투명성, 유연성, 수분 저항성을 동시에 구현할 수 있는 새로운 전극 기술이 요구돼 왔다.)

( )

To overcome these limitations, the research team developed a transparent nanofilm based on a biphasic percolation network (BIPIN), which combines conjugated polymers and fluorinated ionomers within a metal nanowire network. When applied to human skin and the cerebral cortex of mice, it stably recorded biosignals under aqueous environments and two-photon imaging conditions without photo-induced noise, demonstrating higher water resistance and superior electrophysiological signal quality compared to conventional metal electrodes and hydrogels. Furthermore, its simple solution-processed fabrication method and excellent mechanical conformability proved its stable applicability in diverse biological environments. (이러한 한계를 극복하기 위해 연구팀은 금속 나노와이어 네트워크에 공액 고분자와 불소계 이오노머를 결합한 이상(biphasic) 퍼콜레이션 네트워크(이하 BIPIN) 기반의 투명 나노막을 개발했다. 사람 피부와 생쥐 대뇌 피질에 적용한 결과, 수계 환경과 이광자 이미징 조건에서도 광유도 잡음 없이 안정적으로 생체 신호를 기록했으며, 기존 금속 전극과 하이드로젤보다 높은 내수성과 우수한 전기생리 신호 품질을 확인했다. 또한 용액 공정 기반의 간단한 제작 방식과 뛰어난 기계적 형태 순응성을 통해 다양한 생체 환경에서도 안정적으로 활용할 수 있음을 입증했다.)

The developed BIPIN features a structure where fluorinated polymers are uniformly filled within the metal nanonetwork, fabricated via spray and spin-coating-based solution processes. This suppressed moisture and ion penetration, enhanced interfacial adhesion, and maintained high optical transmittance and low resistance increase. Its flexible structure, approximately 200 nm thick, adheres closely to skin and brain tissue, enabling stable biosignal recording and clear optical imaging even under continuous moisture exposure. (개발된 BIPIN은 불소 처리된 고분자를 금속 나노망 내부에 균일하게 채운 구조로, 분사 및 스핀 코팅 기반의 용액 공정을 통해 제작됐다. 이를 통해 수분과 이온의 침투를 억제하고 계면 접착력을 높였으며, 높은 광 투과도와 낮은 저항 증가율을 유지했다. 약 200nm 두께의 유연한 구조는 피부와 뇌 조직에 밀착돼 지속적인 수분 노출 환경에서도 안정적인 생체 신호 기록과 선명한 광학 이미징이 가능했다.)

( )

Experimental results showed that electromyography signals were stably recorded over long periods even in underwater environments like swimming, and pilocarpine-induced local field potentials (LFP) and multi-unit activity (MUA) were also stably measured. Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and cytotoxicity assessments revealed low inflammatory responses, confirming excellent biocompatibility and implantation stability. (실험 결과, 수영과 같은 수중 환경에서도 근전도 신호를 장기간 안정적으로 기록했으며, 필로카르핀으로 유도한 국소장전위(LFP)와 다단위 활동(MUA) 역시 안정적으로 측정했다. 면역형광 염색(IHC)과 세포 독성 평가에서도 낮은 염증 반응을 보여 우수한 생체 적합성과 이식 안정성을 확인했다.)

( )

This study is significant for presenting a moisture-resistant, transparent bio-optoelectronic platform that simultaneously solves the issues of conventional transparent electrodes’ vulnerability to aqueous environments and delamination from biological tissues. In particular, enabling stable electrophysiological signal measurement and optical imaging even in moist environments such as rain or sweat, it is expected to be utilized in various fields including neural circuit research, wearable bioelectronics, and high-resolution bioimaging. (이번 연구는 기존 투명 전극의 수계 환경 취약성과 생체 조직 박리 문제를 동시에 해결한 수분 저항성 투명 생체 광전자 플랫폼을 제시했다는 데 의미가 있다. 특히 비나 땀 등 수분 환경에서도 안정적인 전기생리 신호 측정과 광학 이미징이 가능해 신경 회로 연구, 웨어러블 바이오일렉트로닉스, 고해상도 생체 이미징 등 다양한 분야에 활용될 것으로 기대된다.)

( )

This research was conducted through collaboration among researcher Kim Hyun-woo (co-first author, Yonsei University), researcher Lulu Sun (co-first author, corresponding author, RIKEN), Professor Takao Someya (corresponding author, RIKEN/University of Tokyo), Professor Kenjiro Fukuda (corresponding author, RIKEN/Osaka University), and Professor Yoo Ki-jun (corresponding author, Yonsei University), and has been accepted for final publication in Nature Communications (IF 18.1, JCR Top 5.4%), a sister journal of Nature and a leading international journal for convergence research. This research was supported by the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS), the National Research Foundation of Korea, and the Yoon Jae Fellowship. (본 연구는 김현우 연구원(공동 1저자, 연세대), 루루 쑨(Lulu Sun) 연구원(공동 1저자, 교신저자, RIKEN), 타카오 소메야(Takao Someya) 교수(교신저자, RIKEN/도쿄대), 켄지로 후쿠다(Kenjiro Fukuda) 교수(교신저자, RIKEN/오사카대), 유기준 교수(교신저자, 연세대) 연구팀의 협업을 통해 진행됐으며 Nature 자매지이자 국제 융합연구 최고 권위지인 네이처 커뮤니케이션즈(Nature Communications, IF 18.1, JCR 상위 5.4%, JCR Top 5.4%)에 최종 게재 승인됐다. 본 연구는 일본학술진흥회(JSPS) 지원사업, 한국연구재단의 지원 및 이윤재 Fellowship 등의 지원을 받아 수행됐다.)

item.title: Graduate School of Wonkwang Digital University Successfully Holds 16th International Academic Exchange Seminar on "Multifaceted Approaches to Well-Aging" (원광디지털대 대학원, “웰 에이징을 위한 다각적 접근”...제16회 국제학술교류세미나 성료)
item.description:
The Graduate School of Wonkwang Digital University (Dean Choi Yoon-hee) successfully held the 16th International Academic Exchange Seminar on the 27th at its Seoul Campus. (원광디지털대학교 대학원(원장 최윤희)은 지난 27일, 서울캠퍼스에서 ‘제16회 국제학술교류세미나’를 성공적으로 개최했다.)

Organized by the Wonkwang Natural Health Research Institute and hosted by the Graduate School, the seminar was themed "Multifaceted Approaches to Well-Aging." It was designed to explore integrated approaches for healthy aging in the era of an aging society and to revitalize academic exchanges among domestic and international researchers. (원광자연건강연구소가 주최하고 대학원이 주관한 이번 세미나는 ‘웰 에이징을 위한 다각적 접근’을 주제로, 고령화 시대를 맞아 건강한 노화를 위한 통합적 접근 방안을 모색하고 국내외 연구자 간 학술 교류를 활성화하기 위해 마련됐다.)

()

The event began with opening remarks and a welcome address by Graduate School Dean Choi Yoon-hee, followed by a congratulatory speech by President Kim Yoon-chul. It was conducted in a hybrid online and offline format, allowing active participation from researchers both at home and abroad. (행사는 최윤희 대학원장의 개회사와 환영사, 김윤철 총장의 축사로 막을 올렸으며, 온·오프라인 병행 방식으로 진행돼 국내외 연구자들의 활발한 참여가 이뤄졌다.)

During the seminar, domestic and international experts shared various approaches in the field of well-aging. International speakers included Professor K. Krishna Sharma of Mangalore University, India, who presented on "Yoga Therapy for Geriatric Disease Management," and Claudine LUU, founder of France's IMDERPLAM, who spoke on "IMDERPLAM's Sustainable Beauty and Healthy Life Approach, and the Philosophy of Vital Aging." Subsequently, Professor You Xiangqian of Hunan University of Chinese Medicine, China, gave a lecture on "Prevention and Treatment of Geriatric Lung Diseases with Medicinal Diet Therapy." (세미나에는 국내외 전문가들이 웰 에이징 분야의 다양한 접근 방안을 공유했다. 해외 연사로는 인도 망갈로르대학교 크리슈나 샤르마 교수(K.Krishna Sharma)가 ‘노인 질환 관리 요가 테라피’를, 프랑스 IMDERPLAM 설립자 클로딘 루(Claudine LUU) 대표가 ‘ IMDERPLAM(임더플람)의 지속가능한 아름다움과 건강한 삶의 접근, 그리고 바이탈 에이징 철학’을 주제로 발표했다. 이어 중국 호남중의약대학교 유향전 교수가 ‘노인성 폐질환과 약선식료 예방치료’를 주제로 강연했다.)

()

Domestically, Professor Lee Hyun-jung of the Department of Speech-Language Pathology at Wonkwang Digital University contributed academic depth with a presentation on "Understanding Aging and Swallowing Disorders." (국내에서는 원광디지털대학교 언어치료학과 이현정 교수가 ‘노화와 삼킴장애의 이해’를 발표해 학술적 깊이를 더했다.)

()

Additionally, research results from current master's students and alumni of the Department of Natural Health were presented. Current student Jo Mi-rye introduced research on "Forest, the Second Classroom: A Neuro-Ecological Approach to Enhancing Brain Function in Korean Adolescents," while alumnus Baek Jeong-ae presented on "Case Study of Developing Health-Preserving Medicinal Diet Menus for Seniors (Honey Sleep Snack Set)." (이와 함께 자연건강학과 석사과정 재학생과 졸업생들의 연구 성과 발표도 이어졌다. 조미례 재학생은 ‘숲, 제2의 교실: 한국 청소년의 뇌 기능 향상을 위한 신경·생태학적 접근’을, 백정애 졸업생은 ‘시니어를 위한 양생 약선메뉴개발 사례 발표(꿀잠다과상)’를 주제로 연구 성과를 소개했다.)

Director Myung No-il of the Wonkwang Natural Health Research Institute stated, "We hope this International Academic Exchange Seminar serves as an opportunity to further expand the foundation for integrated research and international cooperation, connecting various fields such as natural healing, diet, exercise, and mental health." (명노일 원광자연건강연구소장은 “이번 국제학술교류세미나가 자연치유와 식생활, 운동, 심신 건강 등 다양한 분야를 연결하는 통합적 연구와 국제 협력의 기반을 더욱 확대하는 계기가 되기를 기대한다”고 전했다.)

()

Graduate School Dean Choi Yoon-hee remarked, "Well-aging is not achieved through a single treatment or discipline but begins with an integrated approach that connects food, nature, movement, mind, and community." She added, "I hope this seminar will further activate cooperation among domestic and international researchers and lead to practical research and education that promotes public health." (최윤희 대학원장은 “웰 에이징은 하나의 치료법이나 학문으로 완성되는 것이 아니라, 음식과 자연, 움직임, 마음, 공동체를 연결하는 통합적 접근에서 시작된다”며 “이번 세미나가 국내외 연구자들의 협력을 더욱 활성화하고, 국민 건강 증진을 위한 실질적인 연구와 교육으로 이어지는 계기가 되길 바란다”고 밝혔다.)

(<이 기사는 원광디지털대학교에서 제공한 정보기사로 한겨레의 의견과 다를 수 있습니다.>)

item.title: Small Business & SME Collective Bargaining Granted 'Cartel Exemption'… Path Opens for Group Negotiations with Large Firms (소상공인·중소기업 단체협상, ‘담합 면제’…대기업과 집단 협상 길 열린다)
item.description:
Going forward, small business owners and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) will be exempt from cartel regulations when engaging in collective bargaining with large and mid-sized companies. Fair trade laws will also not be applied to labor unions' collective actions. (앞으로 소상공인·중소기업이 대기업·중견기업을 대상으로 단체협상을 할 때는 담합 규정 적용을 면제해준다. 노동조합의 단체행동에는 공정거래법을 적용하지 않기로 했다.)

On the 30th, the Fair Trade Commission (FTC) reported a "plan for institutional reforms to strengthen the bargaining power of the weaker party" at a Cabinet meeting. The FTC stated, "We will restructure the legal framework so that collective bargaining, where economically weaker parties like small business owners and SMEs unite to counter stronger entities, does not fall under the prohibited cartel activities of the Fair Trade Act." (공정거래위원회는 30일 국무회의에서 이런 내용의 ‘을의 협상력 강화를 위한 제도 개편방안’을 보고했다. 공정위는 “소상공인·중소기업 등 경제적 약자가 연합해 강자에 대응하는 단체협상 등이 공정거래법상 금지되는 담합에 해당하지 않도록 법 체계를 개편하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

First, small business owners and small enterprises will be able to engage in collective bargaining with large and all mid-sized companies. If all participants in the negotiation are small enterprises (including small business owners) under the Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises, they will be exempt from cartel regulations without review. Once the participants, counterparty, and details of the action are notified to the FTC, it will be immediately permitted, with the exemption effective for five years. The FTC explained that while the need for such alliances is significant, their impact on the market is limited. (우선 소상공인·소기업은 대기업과 모든 중견기업을 대상으로 단체협상을 할 수 있게 된다. 협상 참가자가 모두 중소기업기본법상 소기업(소상공인 포함)이면 심사 없이 담합 규정 적용을 면제한다. 협상 참가자와 상대방, 행위 내용을 공정위에 통지하면 즉시 허용하고, 5년간 효력을 지속하는 방식이다. 이들의 연합 필요성은 큰 반면, 시장에 미치는 영향은 제한적이라는 게 공정위 설명이다.)

If a medium-sized enterprise, which has a greater market impact compared to small enterprises, is included as a participant in the negotiation, the FTC will verify whether the reporting requirements are met and then exempt it from cartel regulations. To meet the requirements, the combined annual sales (or purchases) of the participating businesses must be smaller than that of the counterparty, and each participant's transaction dependency on the counterparty must be 30% or higher. Additionally, the counterparty must be a large or major mid-sized company. Once the FTC confirms compliance and approves, the collective bargaining is permitted immediately, with the exemption effective for three years. (소기업에 견줘 시장 영향이 큰 중기업이 협상 참가자에 포함되면 신고 요건 충족 여부를 확인하고 담합 규정 적용을 면제한다. 요건을 충족하려면 참가 사업자들의 연 매출(매입) 합산액이 협상 상대방보다 작고, 각 참가 사업자의 상대방에 대한 거래의존도가 30% 이상이어야 한다. 또 상대방은 대기업 및 대형 중견기업이어야 한다. 공정위가 요건 충족을 확인하고 수리하는 즉시 단체협상이 허용되며 3년간 효력이 지속된다.)

The FTC stated that when necessary to strengthen the bargaining power of small business owners and SMEs, it will fully allow agreements and information exchanges regarding prices, transaction terms, transaction volumes, and transaction areas among businesses during the negotiation process. Collective actions, such as joint refusal to supply, will also be generally permitted. Bid-rigging will not be allowed, but the FTC plans to reinforce subordinate regulations to prevent large companies from exploiting the bidding process to circumvent this system. (공정위는 소상공인·중소기업의 교섭력 강화에 필요한 경우, 협상 과정에서 수반되는 사업자 간 가격, 거래조건, 거래량, 거래 지역 등에 대한 합의와 정보 교환 등을 전면 허용하겠다고 밝혔다. 공동 납품 거부 등 단체행동도 원칙적으로 허용한다. 입찰담합은 허용하지 않되, 대기업 등이 이 제도를 회피하기 위해 입찰 절차를 악용하지 않도록 하위 규정을 보강하겠다는 계획이다.)

As a result, for instance, self-employed individuals registered on delivery apps can conduct collective bargaining or collective actions to negotiate transaction terms such as fees and settlement cycles. Subcontracting companies may also respond to large firms' demands for lower supply prices by jointly refusing to supply. However, if a collective bargaining leads to a halt in intermediate goods supply, making final goods production impossible and causing a significant rise in consumer prices—markedly harming consumer interests—the FTC can issue a future cease-and-desist order. In such cases, past actions will not be penalized. If there is a risk of serious side effects, such as consumer harm from a boycott, a temporary suspension order may also be imposed. (이에 따라 가령 배달앱에 입점한 자영업자들은 수수료, 정산 주기 등 거래조건 협상을 위해 단체협상이나 단체행동을 할 수 있게 된다. 하도급 기업들이 대기업의 납품단가 인하 요구에 공동 납품 거부로 대응할 수도 있게 된다. 다만 단체협상 이후 중간재 공급 중단으로 최종재 생산이 불가능해지고, 소비자가격이 크게 상승하는 등 소비자 이익에 현저한 침해가 발생하는 경우 공정위는 향후 금지명령을 내릴 수 있다. 이 경우 과거 행위는 제재하지 않는다. 보이콧으로 인한 소비자 피해 등 중대한 부작용 발생 우려가 있는 경우에는 임시중지 명령도 부과할 수 있다.)

Meanwhile, the FTC decided not to apply the Fair Trade Act to collective actions by labor unions. Labor unions that have filed establishment reports or have their status recognized by court rulings or decisions of the Labor Relations Commission, along with their members and service providers (e.g., delivery drivers, truck owners) as defined under industrial accident insurance laws, are exempt from FTC investigations and sanctions. The FTC explained, "This takes into account the substantive guarantee of the three basic labor rights, which are constitutional rights, and recent trends in judicial precedents." (한편, 공정위는 노동조합 등의 단체행동에 대해 공정거래법을 적용하지 않기로 했다. 설립 신고되거나 법원 판결, 노동위원회 결정 등으로 지위를 인정받은 노동조합과 소속 노동자, 택배기사·화물차주 등 산재보험 법령 등에 규정된 노무제공자가 공정거래법 조사·제재 면제 대상이다. 공정위는 “헌법상 기본권인 노동 3권의 실질적 보장 및 최근 판례 경향 등을 고려했다”고 설명했다.)

Previously, the FTC had treated labor unions formed by legally self-employed individuals, such as construction and truck drivers, as business associations and sanctioned their collective actions. Under the Yoon Suk Yeol government, when the Cargo Truckers' Solidarity (CTS) initiated a full-scale strike demanding the abolition of the safe freight rate sunset clause, the FTC attempted to conduct on-site inspections on whether they violated the Fair Trade Act. When the CTS refused, the FTC filed a complaint for obstruction of investigation. As a result, the CTS headquarters was indicted, but a first-instance court last year acquitted them, ruling that the FTC's investigation target was inappropriate. (공정위는 그간 건설·화물노동자 등 법적으로 개인사업자인 이들이 결성한 노동조합을 사업자단체로 보고 이들의 단체행동을 제재한 바 있다. 윤석열 정부 당시 공정위는 화물연대가 안전운임제 일몰제 폐지 등을 요구하며 총파업에 들어가자 공정거래법 위반 여부에 대해 현장조사를 시행하려 했고, 화물연대가 응하지 않자 조사 방해 혐의로 고발한 바 있다. 이 사건으로 화물연대 본부가 기소됐으나 지난해 1심 재판부는 공정위 조사 대상이 아니라며 무죄를 선고했다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-ju kyj@hani.co.kr (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: High-price purchases, maturity mismatches... Financial Supervisory Service: "Securities firms must compensate 60–70% of losses from bond-type wrap accounts" (고가매수·만기 미스매칭…금감원 “증권사, 채권형 랩 손실 60~70% 배상하라”)
item.description:
The financial authorities have decided that securities firms must compensate 60 to 70% of losses incurred by clients who suffered damages from bond-type wrap accounts—discretionary asset management products (typically one-on-one asset management contracts with corporate individual clients) operated by securities firms—due to purchasing commercial paper (CP) and bonds at prices higher than market rates and employing maturity mismatch strategies. This is the first mediation decision to determine whether a discretionary investment manager violated the duty of care (duty of a prudent manager) and fiduciary duty under the Capital Markets Act. (증권사가 운용하는 일임형(주로 법인 개별 고객과 1:1 자산운용 계약) 자산관리 상품인 채권형 랩 어카운트에서 기업어음(CP)·채권을 시장금리 대비 높은 가격에 매수하고, 만기 미스매칭 전략으로 고객에게 손해를 입힌 증권사에 금융당국이 손해액의 60∼70%를 배상하라고 결정했다. 자본시장법상 투자일임업자의 선관주의(선량한 관리자의 주의의무) 및 충실의무 위반 여부를 판단한 최초의 조정 결정이다.)

On the 30th, the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) announced that its Financial Dispute Mediation Committee held a meeting the previous day and made this decision, recognizing Securities Firm A's violation of the duty of care and fiduciary duty. This dispute arose from the 2022 Legoland crisis, which caused a sharp rise in market interest rates and a plunge in bond and CP prices, leading to investment losses in bond-type wrap products. While some securities firms made self-compensations, civil lawsuits and requests for dispute mediation continued over the compensation amounts. The FSS, referencing recent court rulings that recognized securities firms' liability up to 70% of the shortfall from the target return, assessed factors such as whether illegal acts were acknowledged, standards for calculating damages, and the ratio of damages compensation. Based on the compensation standards established this time, the FSS decided that the securities firm should compensate two investors with 70% and 60% of their losses, respectively. Here, the loss amount is the difference between the sum of the target return (including principal) at maturity plus delayed damages up to the actual repayment date, minus the amount actually repaid. (30일 금융감독원은 전날 금융분쟁조정위원회(분조위)를 열고 ㄱ증권사의 선관주의 및 충실의무 위반을 인정해 이같이 결정했다. 이번 분쟁은 2022년 레고랜드 사태로 시중금리가 급등하며 채권·CP 가격이 급락하자 채권형 랩 상품에서도 투자손실이 발생하면서 비롯됐다. 일부 증권사는 자체배상을 했지만 배상 금액을 둘러싸고 민사소송과 분쟁조정 신청이 지속됐다. 금감원은 최근 목표수익률 미달액의 70%까지 증권사 배상 책임을 인정한 법원 판결을 참고해, 불법행위 인정 여부, 손해액 산정기준과 손해배상비율 등을 판단했다. 금감원은 이번에 마련한 배상기준에 따라 증권사가 두 명의 투자자에게 각각 손해액의 70%, 60%씩 배상하도록 결정했다. 여기서 손해액은 만기 시점의 목표수익금(원금포함)과 실제 상환 시점까지의 지연손해금을 더한 금액에서 실제 상환받은 액수를 뺀 차액이다.)

Corporate Investor B invested a total of 80 billion won (with target returns of 4.3% each) in the first and second wrap products of 2023 but incurred a loss of 460 million won. Another corporate investor C invested 15 billion won in the first and second products of the same year (with target returns of 3.6% and 3.8%) but was notified of an estimated loss of 450 million won. The mediation committee determined that Securities Firm A's actions of "purchasing bonds and CP at high prices" and "operating with maturity mismatches" violated the duty of care and fiduciary duty, and recognized the securities firm's liability for damages. According to the compensation ratio, Corporate Investor B is to receive 70% of the loss, amounting to 1.26 billion won, and Corporate Investor C is to receive 60% of the loss, amounting to 390 million won. (투자자 ㄴ법인은 2023년 1·2차 랩상품에 총 800억원(목표수익률 각 4.3%)을 투자했으나, 4억6천만원 손실이 발생했다. 다른 투자자 ㄷ법인도 같은해 1·2차 상품에 150억원을 투자(목표수익률 3.6%, 3.8%)했으나 평가손실 4억5천만원이 발생했다고 통보받았다. 분조위는 ㄱ증권의 ‘채권·CP 고가매수’와 ‘만기 미스매칭운용’ 행위는 선관주의 및 충실의무를 위반한 것으로, 증권사에 손해배상책임이 인정된다고 판단했다. 배상비율에 따라 투자자 ㄴ법인에 손해액의 70%인 12억6천만원, 투자자 ㄷ법인에는 손해액의 60%인 3억9천만원을 각각 배상하도록 했다.)

If the parties accept this mediation proposal within 20 days of its presentation, the mediation will be finalized. The FSS explained, "This clarifies that illegally managing clients' assets not only incurs administrative sanctions but can also lead to civil liability." (당사자가 이번 조정안 제시일로부터 20일 이내 수락하면 조정이 성립한다. 금감원은 “고객의 재산을 위법하게 운용할 경우 행정상의 제재가 부과될 뿐만 아니라, 민사상의 책임도 부과될 수 있다는 점을 명확하게 했다”고 설명했다.)

item.title: Financial authorities to expand 'one-on-one financial counseling for youth' to over 100,000 cases annually (금융위, ‘청년 1:1 재무상담’ 연 10만건 이상으로 늘린다)
item.description:
Starting July 16, the financial authorities will expand one-on-one financial counseling for young people to over 100,000 cases per year. The proportion of counseling sessions in non-capital areas will also be increased. (금융당국이 오는 7월16일부터 시행하는 청년을 대상으로 한 1:1 재무상담 제공을 연 10만건 이상으로 확대한다. 비수도권 상담 비중도 확대한다.)

On the 30th, the Financial Services Commission held the third meeting of the 'Financial Counseling for All Youth' task force (TF) and announced its implementation plan. Counseling centers will be expanded from the current 21 locations to 133 locations (115 banks, 12 securities firms, 6 insurance companies) by July this year, with a focus on banks, and to over 200 locations by year-end. 119 'itinerant financial counselors' will be appointed and deployed. (금융위원회는 30일 ‘청년 모두를 위한 재무상담’ 태스크포스(TF) 3차 회의를 열어 사업 추진방안을 발표했다. 상담 지점을 기존 21개소에서 은행을 중심으로 올 7월 133개소(은행 115개, 증권 12개, 보험 6개), 연내 200개소 이상으로 순차적으로 확대하고 ‘찾아가는 재무상담사’ 119명을 위촉·운영한다.)

'Itinerant financial counseling', where an expert visits the youth at their desired time and place to provide counseling, will also be operated nationwide. In addition, considering the proportion of the youth population in non-capital areas (44.7%), the share of financial institution counseling centers in non-capital areas will be improved from the current approximately 30% to 47%. For youth facing financial difficulties such as low credit scores or excessive debt, specialized counseling services for resolving credit and debt issues will be linked. (청년이 원하는 시간과 장소에 전문가가 찾아가서 상담을 제공하는 ‘찾아가는 재무상담’도 전국적으로 운영한다. 또 금융기관 재무 상담 지점은 비수도권 청년 인구 비중(44.7%)을 감안해 비수도권 지점 비중을 기존 약 30%에서 47%로 개선할 계획이다. 저신용 또는 과도한 부채 등 재무적으로 어려움을 겪는 청년에게는 신용·부채 문제 해결 등에 특화된 상담 서비스를 연계한다.)

'Financial Counseling for All Youth' operates according to the procedure: financial diagnosis → financial counseling application → financial counseling → follow-up counseling, and the entire process is provided free of charge. Youth aged 19 to 34 can apply for financial counseling starting July 6 on the 'Financial Counseling for All Youth' website. Financial counseling sessions will be provided from July 16. Vice Chairman Kwon Dae-young of the Financial Services Commission stated, "The reality is that many young people are unable to systematically manage their finances to build and accumulate assets," adding, "We are establishing a system to support young people in making wise financial decisions, such as savings and investments, tailored to their individual financial situations and goals." (‘청년 모두를 위한 재무상담’은 재무진단→재무상담 신청→재무상담→사후상담 절차에 따라 운영되며, 전 과정은 별도의 비용 없이 무료로 이루어진다. 만 19살에서 만 34살에 해당하는 청년은 다음 달 6일부터 ‘청년 모두를 위한 재무상담’ 누리집에서 재무상담을 신청할 수 있다. 재무상담은 7월16일부터 제공된다. 권대영 금융위 부위원장은 “많은 청년들이 자산형성과 축적을 위한 체계적인 재무관리를 못하고 있는 것이 현실”이라며 “청년이 개개인의 재무상황과 목표에 맞추어 저축, 투자 등 금융 의사결정을 슬기롭게 해나가도록 지원하는 체계를 구축하고 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Facial recognition not mandatory for mobile phone activation… Mobile ID, resident registration abstracts, etc. to be used in tandem (휴대폰 개통 때 ‘안면인증’ 의무화 안 한다…모바일신분증·주민초본 등 병용)
item.description:
The government will gradually introduce a facial recognition system to prevent identity theft phone activations used in voice phishing and burner phone crimes. However, considering users' right to choose regarding the provision of biometric information, alternative verification methods such as mobile IDs and resident registration abstracts will also be operated concurrently. (정부가 보이스피싱과 대포폰 범죄에 활용되는 명의도용 휴대전화 개통을 막기 위해 안면인증 제도를 단계적으로 도입한다. 다만, 생체인식정보 제공에 대한 이용자의 선택권을 고려해 모바일 신분증과 주민등록초본 등 대체 인증수단도 함께 운영하기로 했다.)

The Ministry of Science and ICT announced on the 30th that starting July 6, a multi-step identity verification process will be applied for new mobile phone activations and number porting at in-person and non-face-to-face activation channels of the three major mobile carriers and MVNOs. Earlier, the ministry had considered making facial recognition mandatory for mobile phone activations following a pilot project in December last year. However, the system was revised and supplemented after the Personal Information Protection Commission and the National Human Rights Commission recommended providing alternative verification methods, citing unclear legal grounds for allowing facial information as a means of identity verification and insufficient guarantee of the data subject's right to choose. (과학기술정보통신부는 7월6일부터 이동통신 3사와 알뜰폰 사업자의 대면·비대면 개통 채널에서 휴대전화 신규 개통과 번호이동 때 다중 신원확인 절차를 적용한다고 30일 밝혔다. 앞서 과기정통부는 지난해 12월 시범사업을 거쳐 휴대전화 개통 때 안면인증을 의무화하는 방안을 검토했다. 그러나 개인정보보호위원회와 국가인권위원회가 얼굴정보를 본인인증 수단으로 허용할 법적 근거가 불분명하고, 정보주체의 선택권이 충분히 보장되지 않은 만큼 대체 인증수단 마련을 권고하자 제도를 수정·보완했다.)

Accordingly, users wishing to activate a mobile phone can choose one of the following for identity verification: facial recognition, a mobile ID, or a resident registration abstract issued on the same day. If facial recognition is chosen, the person's identity is confirmed by comparing the photo on their ID with a real-time facial image. If there is a significant difference between the ID photo and the current appearance, or if facial recognition fails due to the shooting environment, identity verification can be done using a mobile ID or resident registration abstract. (이에 따라 앞으로 휴대전화를 개통하려는 이용자는 안면인증, 모바일 신분증, 당일 발급한 주민등록초본 가운데 하나를 선택해 본인 인증을 할 수 있다. 안면인증을 선택한 경우 신분증 사진과 실시간으로 촬영한 얼굴 영상을 대조해 본인 여부를 확인한다. 신분증 사진과 현재 모습의 차이가 크거나 촬영 환경 등으로 안면인증에 실패하면 모바일 신분증이나 주민등록초본을 이용해 본인 확인을 할 수 있다.)

However, as the identity verification process is strengthened, some on-site confusion is expected to be unavoidable in the short term. This is because mobile IDs provided by the Ministry of the Interior and Safety require the app to be installed and issued in advance, and only resident registration abstracts issued on the day of activation are accepted. (다만, 본인 인증 절차가 강화되는 만큼 당분간 현장의 혼란은 불가피할 것으로 전망된다. 행정안전부가 제공하는 모바일 신분증은 애플리케이션을 미리 설치한 뒤 발급받아야 사용할 수 있으며, 주민등록초본도 개통 당일 발급한 서류만 인정되기 때문이다.)

To minimize user inconvenience, the government plans to introduce additional alternative verification methods that can be used without visiting a community service center by August, and in September, it will automatically link the resident registration abstract forgery verification system with the identity verification process. It also plans to revise the enforcement decree of the Telecommunications Business Act in October to clarify the legal basis for facial recognition. (정부는 이용자 불편을 최소화하기 위해 8월까지 주민센터 방문 없이 이용할 수 있는 추가 대체 인증수단을 도입하고, 9월에는 주민등록초본 위·변조 확인 시스템을 본인 확인 절차와 자동 연계할 예정이다. 또한 10월 중 전기통신사업법 시행령을 개정해 안면인증의 법적 근거를 명확히 한다는 계획이다.)

Choi Woo-hyuk, Director of the Information Protection Network Policy Office at the Ministry of Science and ICT, said at a briefing that day, "Facial recognition is not perfect, but it is clearly a strong identity verification system to prevent illegal mobile phone activations," adding, "We are providing alternative verification methods concurrently, considering the convenience and acceptance of the policy by the people." (최우혁 과기정통부 정보보호네트워크정책실장은 이날 브리핑에서 “안면인증이 완벽한 것은 아니지만 휴대전화 부정개통 방지를 위한 강력한 신원확인 시스템인 것은 분명하다”며 “국민의 편의성, 정책 수용도를 고려해 대체 인증수단을 병행하는 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Seon Dam-eun sun@hani.co.kr (선담은 기자 sun@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Crude Oil Supply Crisis Eases: Resource Security Alert Downgraded After Three Months (원유 수급 비상 한고비 넘겼다…자원안보 경보 석 달 만에 하향)
item.description:
The government is lowering the resource security crisis alert for crude oil from "caution" to "watch." This decision comes as crude oil transport through the Strait of Hormuz resumes following the end-of-war negotiations between the US and Iran, alleviating concerns over disruptions in domestic crude oil imports. The two-car restriction for public sector vehicles, implemented after the alert was raised in April, will also be fully lifted. (정부가 원유 자원안보 위기경보를 ‘경계’에서 ‘주의’로 한 단계 낮춘다. 미국과 이란의 종전협상 뒤 호르무즈해협을 통한 원유 수송이 재개되면서 국내 원유 도입 차질 우려가 완화됐다는 판단에서다. 지난 4월 경보 격상 뒤 시행된 공공부문 차량 2부제도 전면 해제된다.)

The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced on the 30th that, following consultations with relevant ministries, the resource security crisis alert for crude oil will be lowered from "caution" to "watch" starting July 1 at midnight. The "watch" alert for natural gas will be lifted. (산업통상부는 관계부처 협의를 거쳐 7월1일 0시부터 원유 자원안보 위기경보를 ‘경계’에서 ‘주의’로 낮춘다고 30일 밝혔다. 천연가스에 내려진 ‘주의’ 경보는 해제한다.)

The resource security crisis alert operates on four levels—"interest-watch-caution-serious"—under the Special Act on National Resource Security. After the outbreak of the Middle East war, the government issued an "interest" alert for crude oil on March 5, and following the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, it successively raised the level to "watch" on March 18 and "caution" on April 2. The natural gas alert was also escalated to "interest" on March 5 and "watch" on April 2. (자원안보 위기경보는 국가자원안보 특별법에 따라 ‘관심-주의-경계-심각’ 등 4단계로 운용된다. 정부는 중동전쟁 발발 뒤인 지난 3월5일 원유 경보를 ‘관심’으로 발령한 뒤 호르무즈해협 봉쇄가 이어지자 3월18일 ‘주의’, 4월2일 ‘경계’로 단계를 잇달아 높였다. 천연가스 경보도 3월5일 ‘관심’, 4월2일 ‘주의’로 격상한 바 있다.)

The government lowered the crude oil alert after three months because the Strait of Hormuz transit has gradually resumed following the signing of the end-of-war Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the US and Iran. According to the government's explanation, six of the seven oil tankers bound for South Korea, which had entered the Persian Gulf inside the Strait of Hormuz and were anchored there before the war, have now passed through the strait and are moving toward South Korea. The Joint Maritime Information Center, a multinational consultative body, has also lowered its assessment of the risk level for transiting the Strait of Hormuz compared to its peak. (정부가 석 달 만에 원유 경보를 낮춘 것은 미국과 이란의 종전 양해각서(MOU) 체결 뒤 호르무즈해협 통항이 단계적으로 재개됐기 때문이다. 정부의 설명을 들으면, 전쟁 발발 전 호르무즈해협 안쪽으로 들어가 페르시아만에 정박해 있던 한국행 유조선 7척 가운데 6척이 해협을 빠져나와 국내로 이동하고 있다. 다국적 협의체인 합동해사정보센터도 호르무즈해협 통항 위험 수준을 정점 때보다 낮춰 평가했다.)

However, the crude oil alert will not be completely lifted and will remain at the "watch" level. This is because the possibility of future production disruptions cannot be ruled out, given that crude oil production and transport facilities in the Middle East region have been attacked. For natural gas, despite Qatar's declaration of force majeure, the government decided to lift the alert considering that alternative supplies have been secured through spot purchases and overseas resource development projects, and international prices, which surged immediately after the war, have stabilized. (다만, 원유 경보는 완전히 해제하지 않고 ‘주의’ 단계를 유지한다. 중동 지역 원유 생산·수송시설이 공격받은 만큼 앞으로 생산 차질이 나타날 가능성을 배제하기 어렵다는 이유에서다. 천연가스는 카타르의 불가항력 선언에도 현물 구매와 해외자원개발 물량 등을 통해 대체 물량을 확보한 데다, 전쟁 직후 급등했던 국제가격도 안정된 점을 고려해 경보를 해제하기로 했다.)

With the downgrading of the alert, emergency supply measures will also be adjusted in stages. The expansion of refunds on petroleum import surcharges for diversifying crude oil import sources and the system for exchanging stockpiled oil will end as scheduled on June 30. Financial support for the difference in naphtha import unit prices will also end on that day, but support will be maintained for volumes contracted by June 30 and imported by August. (경보 하향에 따라 비상 수급 조치도 단계적으로 조정된다. 원유 도입선 다변화를 위한 석유수입부과금 환급 확대와 비축유 교환 제도는 예정대로 6월30일 종료한다. 나프타 수입단가 차액 지원도 이날 종료하되, 6월30일까지 계약을 맺고 8월까지 들여오는 물량까지 지원이 유지된다.)

The two-car restriction for public sector vehicles will be fully lifted, without transitioning to a five-car restriction. During a cabinet meeting on the same day, when the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy reported that it would ease the restriction to a five-car system, President Lee Jae-myung said, "If it's not effective, let's lift it all" and added, "Regulations should be limited to cases where they are absolutely necessary." (공공부문 차량 2부제는 5부제를 거치지 않고 전면 해제하기로 했다. 이재명 대통령은 이날 국무회의에서 산업부가 차량 5부제로 완화하겠다고 보고하자 “실효성이 없으면 다 풀어주는 것으로 하자”며 “규제란 꼭 필요한 경우에 한정해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Regulations will continue for healthcare products, daily necessities, and petrochemical products for essential industries, where supply chain complexity raises concerns about supply bottlenecks. This is because, as these products go through multiple production stages from raw materials to intermediate goods to finished products, disruptions in the supply of specific raw materials could lead to supply instability for final products. Restrictions on naphtha exports and supply adjustment regulations will remain in place until the originally scheduled sunset date of August 26, and bans on hoarding raw materials for petrochemical products and emergency supply adjustment measures will be maintained temporarily even after July. (공급망이 복잡해 수급 병목 우려가 있는 보건의료용 제품과 생활필수품, 필수산업용 석유화학제품은 관련 규제를 이어간다. 원료부터 중간재, 완제품까지 여러 생산 단계를 거치는 탓에 특정 원료의 공급 차질이 최종 제품의 수급 불안으로 이어질 수 있기 때문이다. 나프타 수출 제한과 수급 조정 규정은 애초 일몰 시점인 8월26일까지 존치하고, 석유화학제품 원료 등의 매점매석 금지와 긴급수급조정 조치도 7월 이후에도 당분간 유지한다.)

Reporter Yoo Ha-young yhy@hani.co.kr (유하영 기자 yhy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Inheritance Tax Determined at 8.9 Trillion Won Last Year… Up 9% Following Real Estate Prices (지난해 상속세 결정세액 8.9조…부동산 가격 따라 9% 늘었다)
item.description:
The number of people reporting inheritance tax exceeded 21,000 for the first time last year. The total determined inheritance tax amounted to 8.9 trillion won, a 9% increase from the previous year, attributed to factors such as rising real estate prices. (지난해 상속세 신고인원이 처음으로 2만1천명을 넘긴 것으로 나타났다. 상속세 결정세액은 총 8조9천억원으로 전년 대비 9% 늘었는데, 부동산 가격 상승 등이 영향을 미친 것으로 풀이된다.)

According to the National Tax Service's second-quarter tax statistics for 2026 released on the 30th, the total number of inheritance tax filers last year was counted at 21,741. This is a 7.8% increase (1,574 people) from the previous year, marking the first time the number of filers has exceeded 21,000 since the related statistics began in 2003. The determined tax amount rose by 9% from a year earlier to 8.9345 trillion won. ( 30일 국세청의 2026년 2분기 국세통계를 보면, 지난해 상속세 신고인원은 총 2만1741명으로 집계됐다. 전년 대비 7.8%(1574명) 늘어난 수치로, 신고인원이 2만1천명을 초과한 건 관련 통계 발표를 시작한 2003년 이후 처음이다. 결정세액은 1년 전보다 9% 늘어 8조9345억원으로 집계됐다. )

The increase in inheritance tax filers is due to rising real estate prices in recent years boosting asset values. Among the inherited assets reported last year, real estate such as land and buildings accounted for 68.3% (33.7535 trillion won), making up the vast majority of inherited assets. Last year, the publicly announced prices of apartments and other multi-unit dwellings nationwide rose by 3.65% compared to a year earlier. ( 상속세 신고 인원이 늘어난 건 최근 몇년간 부동산 가격 상승이 자산 가치를 밀어올렸기 때문이다. 지난해 신고된 상속재산 중 토지·건물 같은 부동산 비중은 68.3%(33조7535억원)으로 상속 재산의 절대 다수를 차지하고 있는데, 지난해 아파트를 비롯한 전국 공동주택 공시가격은 1년 전보다 3.65% 오른 바 있다.)

By size of inherited asset value, the bracket exceeding 1 billion won to 2 billion won or less had the most filers at 9,172. The bracket exceeding 500 million won to 1 billion won or less followed with 5,466 filers, with the 2 billion won or less bracket accounting for 68.4% of all filers. In the highest bracket of inherited asset value, exceeding 50 billion won, there were 50 filers, up 10 from the previous year. However, their tax payments amounted to 2.1691 trillion won, a 38% decrease from the previous year (3.4751 trillion won). An official from the National Tax Service explained, "This is because the number of large inheritance cases among ultra-high-net-worth individuals decreased compared to 2024." ( 상속재산 가액 규모별로는 10억원 초과~20억원 이하 구간 신고인원이 9172명으로 가장 많았다. 5억원 초과~10억원 이하 구간이 5466명으로 뒤를 잇는 등 상속재산 20억원 이하 구간이 전체 신고인원의 68.4%를 차지했다. 상속재산 가액 최고구간인 500억원 초과는 전년보다 10명 늘어난 50명이었다. 다만 이들의 납부세액은 2조1691억원으로 전년(3조4751억원) 대비 38% 감소했다. 국세청 관계자는 “초고액 자산가의 대형 상속 건수가 2024년보다 줄었기 때문”이라고 설명했다.)

The family business inheritance deduction (a system that reduces the inheritance tax burden when passing on a small or medium-sized enterprise that has been managed for over 10 years to children, etc.), which has been exploited as a means to avoid inheritance tax and prompted the government to announce major overhauls, saw 257 cases last year, an increase of 41 cases from the previous year. The deduction amount totaled 1.0882 trillion won, up 485.2 billion won from a year earlier, surpassing the 1 trillion won mark for the first time. ( 상속세 회피 수단으로 악용돼 정부가 대대적 손질을 예고한 가업상속공제(10년 이상 경영해온 중소기업을 자녀 등에게 물려줄 경우 상속세 부담 낮춰주는 제도)는 지난해 257건으로 전년 대비 41건 늘었고, 공제금액은 1년 전보다 4852억원 늘어난 1조882억원으로 집계되는 등 처음으로 1조원을 넘겼다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jung shin@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Let’s Unite Through the Social and Solidarity Economy to Open New Opportunities in Every Region" (“사회연대경제로 똘똘 뭉쳐 지역마다 새 기회를 열자”)
item.description:
A "Policy Meeting on the Social and Solidarity Economy for Winners of the 9th Local Elections Under Civilian Leadership" was held on the 29th at The Plaza Hotel in Jung-gu, Seoul, aimed at sharing the direction of social and solidarity economy policies and strengthening cooperation between the central and local governments. Officials from the government, the presidential office, and local governments gathered to agree on the need to revitalize the social and solidarity economy and ensure the swift passage of related legislation through the National Assembly. (사회연대경제 정책의 추진 방향을 공유하고, 중앙과 지방정부 간 협력을 강화하기 위한 ‘민선 9기 지방선거 당선자 사회연대경제 정책 간담회’가 29일 서울 중구 더 플라자 호텔에서 열렸다. 정부와 청와대, 지방자치단체 관계자들이 모여 사회연대경제 활성화와 관련법의 조속한 국회 통과가 필요하다는 데 뜻을 같이했다.)

Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung stated in his opening remarks at the meeting, "The world is turning to the social and solidarity economy as a new solution to challenges such as polarization and care gaps." He added, "If the central and local governments unite tightly through the social and solidarity economy and work together, we can overcome crises and open new opportunities in every region," promising active cooperation from the central government. The social and solidarity economy refers to economic activities that prioritize people, communities, and regional values, solving local and social issues through cooperation and solidarity. Representative examples include social enterprises, village enterprises, and cooperatives. The Lee Jae-myung administration is focusing on revitalizing the social and solidarity economy in four key areas—care, housing, energy, and farming/fishing villages—with the Ministry of the Interior and Safety acting as the lead ministry driving the implementation plan. <<> At the meeting, voices called for the enactment of the Framework Act on the Social and Solidarity Economy, which has been repeatedly proposed and scrapped in the National Assembly since its first proposal in 2014, now in its 13th year. The bill has passed the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, but its submission to the plenary session has been delayed due to a lack of cooperation from the People Power Party. Rep. Bok Ki-wang, chairman of the Democratic Party's Social Economy Committee, expressed hope at the meeting, saying, "Best practices for the social and solidarity economy can only be created in local areas, and if you set examples in the field, we can definitely achieve the enactment of the law." Rep. Kim Young-bae, head of the Democratic Party's Legislative Promotion Team for the Social and Solidarity Economy, also affirmed his legislative commitment, stating, "In a society that prioritizes competition, I will strive to enact the Framework Act on the Social and Solidarity Economy so that it becomes a standard in our society." <<> During the meeting, Lee Bang-mu, Director of the Social and Solidarity Economy Bureau at the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, presented the expected effects of the framework law and directions for cooperation between central and local governments. Director Lee explained, "The social and solidarity economy is an economy that provides warm support and solidarity to vulnerable and struggling people. If the Framework Act on the Social and Solidarity Economy is enacted, it will enable the expansion of markets, such as priority purchasing by public institutions and priority consideration in public service outsourcing, as well as establish a basis for government support for social and solidarity financial intermediaries and dedicated agencies." Director Lee also highlighted issues requiring local government cooperation in the government's implementation of the "Comprehensive Plan for the Development of the Social and Solidarity Economy," including: △establishing and operating support centers in each city and province along with overall coordination of individual intermediary organizations; △enhancing education and training for public officials and public sector workers; △participating in publicly funded project competitions; and △providing interest subsidy support for loan products exclusively for social and solidarity economy organizations. <<> Participants reached a consensus that seamless cooperation between the government, the presidential office, and local governments is more necessary than ever to ensure the social and solidarity economy takes root at the local level. Kim Bo-ra, Chairperson of the National Association of Local Governments for the Social and Solidarity Economy (Mayor of Anseong, Gyeonggi Province), assessed, "Since 2014, we have been working to achieve cooperation among local governments by leveraging the value of solidarity, and we have seen results with the Ministry of the Interior and Safety being designated as the lead ministry and this being promoted as a national task." She added, "I hope this meeting becomes a starting point for expanding cooperation in local areas." Ha Seung-chang, Chairman of the Korea Social Value Solidarity Fund, expressed optimism, saying, "Just as a new Social and Solidarity Economy Bureau has been established within the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, interest in the social and solidarity economy is higher than ever. The moment the framework law is enacted, conditions for more active efforts will be created." Bae Jin-gyo, Secretary for Public Listening at the presidential office, stated, "Discussions on projects have already begun in 11 ministries, and plans are being established to enable local governments to work well. (The presidential office) will also cooperate." <<> Many local government heads and winners attended the event, including Kim Bo-ra, Mayor of Anseong; Woo Seung-hee, Governor of Yeongam County, South Jeolla; Kim Mi-kyung, Head of Eunpyeong-gu, Seoul; Park Seung-won, Mayor of Gwangmyeong, Gyeonggi; Yoo Bo-hwa, Head of Seongdong-gu, Seoul (mayor-elect); Choi Ki-chan, Head of Geumcheon-gu, Seoul (mayor-elect); Jung Chang-soo, Head of Gangbuk-gu, Seoul (mayor-elect); Park Un-ki, Head of Seodaemun-gu, Seoul (mayor-elect); Lee Ki-hyung, Mayor of Gimpo, Gyeonggi (mayor-elect); Son Hwa-jung, Head of Yeongjong-gu, Incheon (mayor-elect); Choi Dong-min, Head of Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul (mayor-elect); Choi Hyun-deok, Mayor of Namyangju, Gyeonggi (mayor-elect); Seong Su-seok, Mayor of Icheon, Gyeonggi (mayor-elect); Shin Dong-hwa, Mayor of Guri, Gyeonggi (mayor-elect); Jang Shin-sang, Governor of Hoengseong County, Gangwon (mayor-elect); Jeong Myeong-geun, Mayor of Hwaseong, Gyeonggi (Son Se-young, Director of Basic Society Affairs, attended on his behalf); Choi Dae-ho, Mayor of Anyang, Gyeonggi (Jeong Gyeong-jin, Director of External Cooperation, attended on his behalf); and Kim Han-jong, Governor of Jangseong County, South Jeolla (Go Jae-in, Director of Population Policy Office, attended on his behalf). Kim Soo-young, Senior Researcher at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute sy26@hani.co.kr ( 윤호중 행정안전부 장관은 이날 간담회 인사말에서 “세계는 양극화, 돌봄 공백 등과 같은 난제를 해결할 새로운 해법으로 사회연대경제에 주목하고 있다”며 “중앙과 지역이 사회연대경제로 똘똘 뭉쳐 함께 뛰면 위기를 넘어 지역마다 새로운 기회를 열 수 있다”며 중앙정부의 적극적 협력을 약속했다. 사회연대경제는 사람과 공동체, 지역 가치 등을 우선하며 협력과 연대를 바탕으로 지역·사회 문제를 풀어가는 경제 활동을 말한다. 사회적기업, 마을기업, 협동조합 등이 대표적이다. 이재명 정부는 돌봄·주거·에너지·농어촌 등 4대 분야를 중심으로 사회연대경제 활성화에 초점을 맞추고 있으며, 행안부가 주무 부처로서 실행 계획을 추진하고 있다. )

item.title: "Honam Semiconductor: Even Infrastructure Will Take 5 Years" – President Lee: "No Delays Even by a Month" (“호남 반도체, 기반 조성에만 5년”…이 대통령 “1개월도 지연 없게”)
item.description:
The government announced on the 30th that it plans to complete the construction of infrastructure for the Honam semiconductor cluster within five years. The day before, the presidential office stated it would accelerate the development of the industrial complex to begin construction of semiconductor fabs (production facilities) during President Lee Jae-myung's term, but this timetable appears tight even for completing the infrastructure. <<> At 3 PM that day, a "National Report on the Development Vision for High-Tech Industries in the Southwestern Region" was held in Gwangju Metropolitan City, attended by President Lee Jae-myung, key presidential aides, ministers from relevant ministries including the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, Min Hyung-bae, the governor-elect of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Metropolitan City, and executives from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. This was a follow-up briefing to the "National Report on the Three Mega Projects" held at the presidential office the previous day. <<> At the event, Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jung-gwan, designated as the "semiconductor czar," explained the "Strategy for Fostering High-Tech Industries in the Southwestern Region." According to materials prepared by the Ministry for the event, operating four semiconductor fabs, which would cost 800 trillion won to build, would require 6.3 GW of electricity, 650,000 tons of water (daily), 1.6 million pyeong of land, and 30,000 skilled workers. <<> In particular, the government pledged to drastically shorten the time needed to build the industrial complex equipped with such infrastructure. While it previously took 10 years, they aim to reduce this to five years by accelerating the process as much as possible. The Ministry stated it would significantly ease regulations, such as permitting procedures, and provide up to 100% support from national and local funds to prevent companies from spending money on building the cluster infrastructure. <<> Regarding this, a government official said, "The five-year period refers to completing the infrastructure. There are various permitting processes, and we plan to simplify them and push ahead as quickly as possible." The official added, "It would be difficult to proceed with construction of the semiconductor fabs simultaneously with the infrastructure work. Production facility construction can likely only begin once the infrastructure is in place." <<> Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which announced astronomical investment plans worth up to 4,700 trillion won the previous day, are taking a cautious approach, not disclosing specific details about their investment schedule for the Honam semiconductor cluster. Analysts suggest this may be due to a mix of factors: unlike the government's view that the semiconductor super-boom will last longer than in the past, there are concerns that a decline in demand and supply glut could come sooner; and a sense of relief that the two companies have already secured full government support for the Yongin semiconductor specialized complex, where they are already building production facilities. <<> However, at the event, President Lee Jae-myung stated, "With the implementation of the Special Semiconductor Act in August, a special committee to strengthen the competitiveness of the semiconductor industry will be launched. I, as President, will directly chair it and turn it into a powerful control tower for investments in the southwestern region," revealing his determination to complete the project within his term. In particular, he said, "I will establish a dedicated team at the presidential office to ensure there are no delays, even by a single month, after announcing the plans, and will responsibly support the entire process from start to finish." <<> Kim Nam-il, Reporter namfic@hani.co.kr (정부가 30일 호남 반도체 클러스터가 들어설 기반시설 조성을 5년 안에 마치겠다는 계획을 발표했다. 전날 청와대는 이재명 정부 임기 내 반도체 팹(생산 시설) 공사 시작을 목표로 산업단지 조성에 속도를 내겠다고 했는데, 기반시설을 갖추기에도 빠듯한 시간표인 셈이다.)

item.title: Homeplus at a Crossroads Between Rehabilitation and Liquidation, Submits ‘Restructuring Recovery Plan’… Will It Convince the Court? (청산 갈림길 홈플러스, ‘구조조정 회생안’ 제출…법원 설득할까)
item.description:
Homeplus, standing at a crossroads between rehabilitation and liquidation, faces yet another critical juncture. As the Seoul Bankruptcy Court demanded the submission of a concrete plan for additional funding by the 30th, Homeplus instead submitted an amended rehabilitation plan emphasizing profitability improvements through restructuring, rather than securing funds, in an effort to persuade the court. (회생과 청산의 갈림길에 놓인 홈플러스가 또 한 번 중대 고비를 맞았다. 서울회생법원이 30일까지 추가 자금 조달을 위한 구체적 계획을 제출하라고 요구한 가운데, 홈플러스는 자금 조달 대신 구조조정에 따른 수익성 개선을 강조한 수정회생계획안 변경안을 제출하며 법원 설득에 나섰다.)

Homeplus submitted an amended rehabilitation plan to the Seoul Bankruptcy Court on the 29th. This follows the court’s earlier request, via a formal opinion inquiry sent to Homeplus’s labor and management, its largest shareholder MBK Partners, and the creditor council, for a detailed plan on securing additional funding. (홈플러스는 지난 29일 서울회생법원에 수정회생계획안 변경안을 제출했다. 앞서 서울회생법원이 홈플러스 노사와 최대주주인 엠비케이(MBK)파트너스, 채권자협의회 등에 의견조회 공문을 보내 추가 자금 조달 방안을 구체적으로 제시하라고 요구한 데 따른 것이다.)

In its rehabilitation plan submitted to the court in December of last year, Homeplus proposed raising a total of 300 billion won in emergency operating funds (DIP), with MBK Partners, the Industrial Bank of Korea, and Meritz Financial Group each contributing 100 billion won. However, only 100 billion won from MBK Partners was actually contributed. As a result, the court demanded the submission of a concrete plan by the 30th, ahead of the deadline for the approval of Homeplus’s rehabilitation plan scheduled for the 3rd of next month. (홈플러스는 지난해 12월 법원에 낸 회생계획안에서 엠비케이파트너스, 산업은행, 메리츠금융그룹 등이 각각 1천억원씩 총 3천억원의 긴급운영자금(DIP)을 마련하는 방안을 제시했다. 하지만 실제 투입된 자금은 엠비케이파트너스가 낸 1천억원에 그쳤다. 이에 법원은 오는 3일로 예정된 홈플러스 회생계획안 가결 기한을 앞두고 30일까지 구체적 방안을 제출하라고 한 것이다.)

The amended rehabilitation plan submitted by Homeplus to the court the previous day includes the outcomes of the restructuring efforts undertaken since Homeplus filed for rehabilitation in March of last year. It details a reduction of various costs by 1.2 trillion won compared to the time just before the rehabilitation filing, achieved through store and workforce reductions, rent cuts, and the separate sale of Homeplus Express. Based on this, Homeplus emphasized the improvement in business viability, claiming that normalizing operations could generate operating profits of around 80 billion won, with the potential to increase operating profits to 150 billion won within three years. (전날 홈플러스가 법원에 제출한 수정회생계획안 변경안에는 홈플러스가 지난해 3월 회생 신청 이후 추진한 구조조정 성과가 담겼다. 점포·인력 감축과 임대료 인하, 홈플러스 익스프레스 분리 매각 등을 통해 회생 신청 직전보다 각종 비용을 1조2천억원 줄였다는 내용이다. 홈플러스 쪽은 이를 토대로 영업이 정상화되면 800억원대 영업이익을 낼 수 있고, 3년 내 영업이익이 1500억원까지 늘어날 수 있다며 사업성 개선을 강조했다.)

Meanwhile, five political parties—the Democratic Party of Korea, the Rebuilding Korea Party, the Progressive Party, the Basic Income Party, and the Social Democratic Party—have decided to launch a joint response at the National Assembly level to prevent the collapse of Homeplus and mass unemployment. They aim to strengthen the National Assembly’s mediation role, push for an extension of the rehabilitation deadline, call for government measures, and urge the formation of a social dialogue body. (한편, 더불어민주당과 조국혁신당, 진보당, 기본소득당, 사회민주당 등 5개 정당은 홈플러스 회생과 대규모 실업 사태 방지를 위해 국회 차원의 공동 대응에 나서기로 했다. 이들은 국회의 중재 역할을 강화하고 회생 기한 연장, 정부의 대책 마련, 사회적 대화 기구 구성을 촉구하기로 했다.)

Reported by Seo Hyemi and Kim Chaewun ham@hani.co.kr (서혜미 김채운 기자 ham@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Dongtan·Giheung·Guri Designated with ‘Triple Regulations’ Including Land Transaction Permit Zone… Will Home Price Surge Be Curbed? (동탄·기흥·구리 토허제 포함 ‘3중 규제’ 지정…집값 상승세 꺾일까)
item.description:
The government’s decision on the 30th to designate Hwaseong Dongtan-gu, Yongin Giheung-gu, and Guri-si as ‘triple regulation zones’—subject to adjustment target areas, speculative overheating districts, and land transaction permit zones—stems from the recent abnormal overheating of the apartment market in these areas. According to a survey by the Korea Real Estate Board, as of the fourth week of June (June 22), the cumulative increase in apartment sale prices for these three regions was 11.38% for Dongtan, 7.87% for Guri-si, and 6.21% for Yongin Giheung-gu. However, there is a prevailing sentiment in the local real estate market that this regulation designation came ‘one beat too late.’ <<> With these three areas newly included as regulated zones, lending, subscriptions, and taxation will be tightened. In adjustment target areas and speculative overheating districts, the loan-to-value (LTV) ratio for those without a home (including those with one home subject to sale conditions) will be strengthened from 70% to 40%, and loans to existing homeowners will be completely banned. For multi-homeowners, capital gains tax will be increased: 20 percentage points for two homes and 30 percentage points for three or more homes above the basic tax rate (6–45%), and the long-term holding special deduction will be excluded. The requirement for tax exemption on capital gains for one household with one home will add a two-year residency requirement in addition to the two-year holding period. Additionally, acquisition tax will be double-charged at 8% for two-home owners and 12% for three-home owners, and the exclusion of private rental housing from comprehensive real estate tax aggregation will be removed. <<> The most significant change is the ban on ‘gap investments’ (purchasing homes with leasehold loans) due to the designation as a land transaction permit zone. Homebuyers must move in within four months of receiving land transaction approval from the authorities and reside there for two years. However, for cases where a non-homeowner purchases a home with existing tenants by the end of this year, the obligation to actually reside is deferred until the expiration date of the existing lease contract. <<> The real estate industry expects that with this government measure, the housing market in these three areas will cool down, transaction volumes will decrease, and the soaring apartment prices will taper off. Ham Young-jin, head of the Woori Bank Real Estate Research Lab, predicted, “With the restriction on gap investments due to the land transaction permit system, the buying sentiment will likely shrink, especially for new buildings and station-area complexes that have surged in recent months. From the 5th, when the effect of the land transaction permit zone designation takes effect, transaction volumes will decrease, and a standoff between would-be sellers and actual buyers will begin.” However, there are concerns that the shock effect of regulating Dongtan and Yongin Giheung might be short-lived, given that apartment prices in southern Gyeonggi Province’s so-called ‘shuttle-seon’ (commuter shuttle bus zones for semiconductor clusters) rose sharply even when designated as regulated areas. For instance, Yongin Suji-gu (9.45%) and Suwon Yeongtong-gu (6.15%), both representative shuttle-seon areas, were designated as regulated zones and land transaction permit areas under last year’s ‘October 15 measures,’ yet their apartment sale prices still saw significant increases this year. <<> In the local real estate market, such as Hwaseong Dongtan-gu, there is a sense that the regulation designation came one beat too late. A licensed real estate agent in Yeoul-dong, Hwaseong Dongtan-gu, said, “With rumors circulating that it would soon be designated as a regulated area, many buyers looking to purchase with leasehold loans have hurriedly signed contracts recently. Conversely, actual buyers have been waiting for prices to drop after the regulation designation, so if offer prices adjust, there will likely be buying momentum.” In the case of ‘Dongtan Station Lotte Castle,’ considered the leader in the Dongtan station area, the actual transaction price for an exclusive area of 84㎡ stood at 2.225 billion won in June, setting a new high of over 700 million won more than early this year, while selling offers soared to 2.5 billion won. However, purchase inquiries have now dried up. <<> Choi Jong-hoon, Senior Reporter cjhoon@hani.co.kr (정부가 30일 경기 화성 동탄구, 용인 기흥구, 구리시를 조정대상지역·투기과열지구·토지거래허가구역 등 ‘3중 규제지역’으로 묶은 것은 이들 지역 아파트시장이 최근 비정상적으로 과열된 데 따른 것이다. 한국부동산원 조사를 보면, 6월 넷째 주(6월22일 기준)까지 이들 3곳의 아파트 매매가격 누적 상승률은 동탄 11.38%, 구리시 7.87%, 용인 기흥구 6.21%를 각각 기록했다. 다만 현지 부동산 시장 등에서는 이번 규제지역 지정이 ‘한 박자’ 늦었다는 분위기가 감지된다.)

item.title: Soaring Exchange Rate: BOK Spent $13.6 Billion Defending the Won in Q1 Alone (고공행진 환율…한은, 1분기에만 환율 방어로 136억달러 투입)
item.description:
As the won-dollar exchange rate continues its upward climb, South Korea's foreign exchange authorities sold over 10 billion dollars (approximately 15.5 trillion won) in the first quarter of this year. Despite such intervention, the won's decline continues unabated. (원-달러 환율의 고공행진이 계속되면서 외환당국이 지난 1분기 100억달러(약 15조5천억원) 넘게 내다 판 것으로 나타났다. 이런 당국 개입에도 환율의 고공 행진은 연일 이어지고 있다.)

According to the Bank of Korea's market stabilization measures for the first quarter released on the 30th, the foreign exchange authorities net sold 13.628 billion dollars to stabilize the market. This accounts for over 60% of the record high net sales of 22.467 billion dollars in the fourth quarter of last year. The trend marks the sixth consecutive quarter of net sales since the fourth quarter of 2024. The total net sales during this period amount to 45.352 billion dollars. The Bank of Korea and the Ministry of Economy and Finance have been disclosing the net difference between dollar purchases and sales by the foreign exchange authorities quarterly since the third quarter of 2019. (한국은행이 30일 공개한 올해 1분기 시장안정화 조치 내역을 보면, 외환당국은 외환시장 안정 목적으로 136억2800만달러를 순매도한 것으로 집계됐다. 분기 기준 역대 최고 순매도를 기록한 지난해 4분기 때(224억6700만달러)의 60%를 웃도는 수준이다. 2024년 4분기부터 6개 분기 연속 순매도 흐름이다. 이 기간 총 순매도 규모는 453억5200만달러에 이른다. 한은과 재정경제부는 2019년 3분기부터 분기별로 외환 당국의 달러 매수와 매도의 차액을 공개하고 있다.)

However, despite the active intervention, the won-dollar exchange rate continues to rise. Based on the weekly closing price, it stood at 1,439.7 won at the end of February, shortly after the US-Israel-Iran conflict, then rose to 1,530.1 won at the end of the first quarter, and on the 30th, it approached 1,550 won. (다만 외환당국의 적극적인 개입에도 원-달러 환율 상승세는 이어지고 있다. 주간거래 종가 기준으로 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 직후인 2월말 1439.7원을 기록하더니, 1분기말엔 1530.1원으로 올랐으며, 30일엔 1550원에 바짝 다가섰다.)

On this day, the won-dollar exchange rate in the Seoul foreign exchange market closed at 1,549.4 won, up 4.2 won from the previous day. This is the highest level since March 6, 2009 (1,550 won), during the global financial crisis. (이날 서울 외환시장에서 원-달러 환율 주간거래 종가는 전날보다 4.2원 상승한 1549.4원을 기록했다. 글로벌 금융위기 당시인 2009년 3월6일(1550원) 이후 최고 수준이다.)

The rise in the exchange rate is attributed to a combination of a strong US dollar, net selling of domestic stocks by foreign investors, and the yen's weakness. As expectations grow that the US Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise interest rates within the year, the dollar has strengthened, with the dollar index (a measure of the dollar's value against six major currencies) soaring in the 101 range. (환율 상승세는 미 달러화 강세 분위기 속에 외국인 투자자의 국내 주식 순매도, 엔화 약세가 겹쳤기 때문으로 풀이된다. 미 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)가 연내 금리를 인상할 것이라는 전망에 힘이 실리며 달러화가 강세를 보여 달러인덱스(주요 6개국 통화 대비 달러화 가치)는 101대에서 고공 행진하고 있다.)
